twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” After Jesus got into a boat, what did he do and what did the people do?
twenty_pointers.answer: Once again Jesus began teaching by the lakeshore. A very large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat in the boat while all the people remained on the shore.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” How did Jesus teach the people?
twenty_pointers.answer: He taught them by telling many stories in the form of parables, such as this one:

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” Some of the seed did what, and the birds did what?
twenty_pointers.answer: As he scattered it across his field, some of the seed fell on a footpath, and the birds came and ate it.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” Why did the plant die?
twenty_pointers.answer: But the plant soon wilted under the hot sun, and since it didn't have deep roots, it died.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 3-Part answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” The seed on fertile soil did what?
twenty_pointers.answer: Still other seeds fell on fertile soil, and they sprouted, grew, and produced a crop that was thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times as much as had been planted!

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” When was Jesus asked what the parables meant?
twenty_pointers.answer: Later, when Jesus was alone with the twelve disciples and with the others who were gathered around, they asked him what the parables meant.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” What were disciples permitted to understand?
twenty_pointers.answer: the secret of the Kingdom of God

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” Jesus used parables for what?
twenty_pointers.answer: He replied, “You are permitted to understand the secreta of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables for everything I say to outsiders,”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” When won’t people understand?
twenty_pointers.answer: so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled: ‘When they see what I do, they will learn nothing. When they hear what I say, they will not understand. Otherwise, they will turn to me and be forgiven.’

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 4. What will result when people, quote, “hear what I say”?
twenty_pointers.answer: When they see what I do, they will learn nothing. When they hear what I say, they will not understand. Otherwise, they will turn to me and be forgiven.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 4. According to verse 14, a farmer does what and how?
twenty_pointers.answer: The farmer plants seed by taking God's word to others.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” Whom does the seed on the footpath represent?
twenty_pointers.answer: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message, only to have Satan come at once and take it away.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give 2 complete answers. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” When might people fall away?
twenty_pointers.answer: But since they don't have deep roots, they don't last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God's word.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” What results when the message is crowded out by, quote, “worries of this life, the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things”?
twenty_pointers.answer: but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the worries of this life, the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things, so no fruit is produced.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” Describe the harvest of those who, quote, “hear and accept God's word.”
twenty_pointers.answer: And the seed that fell on good soil represents those who hear and accept God's word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Lamp.” What will happen when a lamp is placed, quote, “on a stand”?
twenty_pointers.answer: its light will shine

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. From the section titled, “Parable of the Lamp.” Where will everything that is hidden be brought, and where will every secret be brought?
twenty_pointers.answer: For everything that is hidden will eventually be brought into the open, and every secret will be brought to light.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Lamp.” Who should understand?
twenty_pointers.answer: Anyone with ears to hear

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Lamp.” What will be taken away from those who are, quote, “not listening”?
twenty_pointers.answer: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 3-Part question. From the section titled, “Parable of the Growing Seed.” Who scatters what, where?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus also said, “The Kingdom of God is like a farmer who scatters seed on the ground.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Growing Seed.” What happens night and day?
twenty_pointers.answer: Night and day, while he's asleep or awake, the seed sprouts and grows, but he does not understand how it happens.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Growing Seed.” What does the earth do?
twenty_pointers.answer: The earth produces the crops on its own.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Growing Seed.” Why does the farmer harvest the grain?
twenty_pointers.answer: And as soon as the grain is ready, the farmer comes and harvests it with a sickle, for the harvest time has come.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 4. A mustard seed becomes what?
twenty_pointers.answer: but it becomes the largest of all garden plants; it grows long branches, and birds can make nests in its shade.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Mustard Seed.” What were similar?
twenty_pointers.answer: stories and illustrations

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. From the section titled, “Parable of the Mustard Seed.” Who taught whom?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus used many similar stories and illustrations to teach the people as much as they could understand.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Mustard Seed.” Afterward, what did Jesus do?
twenty_pointers.answer: In fact, in his public ministry he never taught without using parables; but afterward, when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 4. Concerning boats, which parenthetical statement is contained?
twenty_pointers.answer: (although other boats followed)

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 4. What were high waves doing?
twenty_pointers.answer: But soon a fierce storm came up. High waves were breaking into the boat, and it began to fill with water.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Calms the Storm.” To Jesus, disciples asked which question?
twenty_pointers.answer: Teacher, don't you care that we're going to drown?

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Calms the Storm.” When Jesus was sleeping, what did the disciples do and say?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus was sleeping at the back of the boat with his head on a cushion. The disciples woke him up, shouting, “Teacher, don't you care that we're going to drown?”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Calms the Storm.” What happened when Jesus rebuked the wind?
twenty_pointers.answer: When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Silence! Be still!” Suddenly the wind stopped, and there was a great calm.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Calms the Storm.” To the disciples, which questions did Jesus ask?
twenty_pointers.answer: Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Calms the Storm.” To each other, the disciples asked what and exclaimed what?
twenty_pointers.answer: Who is this man? M 4:41 Even the wind and waves obey him!

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” Which region is mentioned?
twenty_pointers.answer: the region of the Gerasenes

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence question. From Mark chapter 5. Give in essence the opening verse.
twenty_pointers.answer: So they arrived at the other side of the lake, in the region of the Gerasenes.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” When did a man come out from the tombs to meet Jesus?
twenty_pointers.answer: When Jesus climbed out of the boat, a man possessed by an evil spirit came out from the tombs to meet him.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” After making the crowd leave, what did Jesus do?
twenty_pointers.answer: The crowd laughed at him. But he made them all leave, and he took the girl's father and mother and his three disciples into the room where the girl was lying.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” The demon-possessed man was often put into what?
twenty_pointers.answer: chains and shackles

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give 2 complete answers. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” Where did the demon-possessed man wander, quote, “day and night”?
twenty_pointers.answer: Day and night he wandered among the burial caves and in the hills, howling and cutting himself with sharp stones.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” When did the demon-possessed man see Jesus?
twenty_pointers.answer: When Jesus was still some distance away, the man saw him, ran to meet him, and bowed low before him.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, "Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man." How did the demon-possessed man complete this phrase, quote, "Son of"?
twenty_pointers.answer: the Most High God

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Statement and question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” Jesus gave the evil spirit one command. Give this command.
twenty_pointers.answer: For Jesus had already said to the spirit, “Come out of the man, you evil spirit.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” Why was the spirit's name Legion?
twenty_pointers.answer: Then Jesus demanded, “What is your name?” And he replied, “My name is Legion, because there are many of us inside this man.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” What was on the hillside nearby?
twenty_pointers.answer: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding on the hillside nearby.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation completion question. From Mark chapter 5. Finish this verse, quote, “Send us into...”
twenty_pointers.answer: “Send us into those pigs,” the spirits begged. “Let us enter them.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” What came out of whom?
twenty_pointers.answer: So Jesus gave them permission. The evil spirits came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd of about 2,000 pigs plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. 3-Part answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” Who fled where?
twenty_pointers.answer: The herdsmen fled to the nearby town and the surrounding countryside, spreading the news as they ran. People rushed out to see what had happened.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” What resulted when the crowd saw the man, quote, “fully clothed and perfectly sane”?
twenty_pointers.answer: A crowd soon gathered around Jesus, and they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons. He was sitting there fully clothed and perfectly sane, and they were all afraid.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” Those who had seen what happened did what?
twenty_pointers.answer: Then those who had seen what happened told the others about the demon-possessed man and the pigs.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: From Mark chapter 5. How does verse 17 describe the crowd?
twenty_pointers.answer: And the crowd began pleading with Jesus to go away and leave them alone.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” The word “great” is used to describe what?
twenty_pointers.answer: things Jesus had done for him

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Jesus went back where?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus got into the boat again and went back to the other side of the lake, where a large crowd gathered around him on the shore.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” According to verse 22, who fell at whose feet?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jairus, Jesus

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” When Jairus saw Jesus, what did he do?
twenty_pointers.answer: Then a leader of the local synagogue, whose name was Jairus, arrived. When he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet,

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give 2 complete answers. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Jairus asked Jesus to do what?
twenty_pointers.answer: pleading fervently with him. “My little daughter is dying,” he said. “Please come and lay your hands on her; heal her so she can live.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 5. Over the years, what had the woman done?
twenty_pointers.answer: She had suffered a great deal from many doctors, and over the years she had spent everything she had to pay them, but she had gotten no better. In fact, she had gotten worse.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” How did the woman come up to Jesus?
twenty_pointers.answer: She had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him through the crowd and touched his robe.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give 2 complete answers. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Realizing that power had gone out from him, what did Jesus do?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus realized at once that healing power had gone out from him, so he turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my robe?”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 5. Turning around in the crowd, which question did Jesus ask?
twenty_pointers.answer: Who touched my robe?

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 5. Verse 31 contains which questions?
twenty_pointers.answer: How can you ask, ‘Who touched me? Who touched me?

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” The woman told Jesus what?
twenty_pointers.answer: what she had done

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” The woman realized what?
twenty_pointers.answer: Then the frightened woman, trembling at the realization of what had happened to her, came and fell to her knees in front of him and told him what she had done.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” According to the messengers, there’s no use doing what?
twenty_pointers.answer: While he was still speaking to her, messengers arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. They told him, “Your daughter is dead. There's no use troubling the Teacher now.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” When did Jesus see much commotion?
twenty_pointers.answer: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw much commotion and weeping and wailing.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” According to Jesus, the child wasn’t what but was what?
twenty_pointers.answer: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child isn't dead; she's only asleep.”

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Where did Jesus take the girl's father and mother?
twenty_pointers.answer: The crowd laughed at him. But he made them all leave, and he took the girl's father and mother and his three disciples into the room where the girl was lying.

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” What happened after Jesus said to the little girl, quote, “talitha koum”?
twenty_pointers.answer: And the girl, who was twelve years old, immediately stood up and walked around!

twenty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Jesus gave orders not to do what?
twenty_pointers.answer: Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anyone what had happened, and then he told them to give her something to eat.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence question. From Mark chapter 4. Give in essence the opening verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: Once again Jesus began teaching by the lakeshore. A very large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat in the boat while all the people remained on the shore.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” What happened later?
thirty_pointers.answer: Later, when Jesus was alone with the twelve disciples and with the others who were gathered around, they asked him what the parables meant.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” To disciples who asked what the parables meant, what did Jesus say?
thirty_pointers.answer: He replied, “You are permitted to understand the secret of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables for everything I say to outsiders,”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 4. Which Old Testament Scripture is contained?
thirty_pointers.answer: When they see what I do, they will learn nothing. When they hear what I say, they will not understand. Otherwise, they will turn to me and be forgiven.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 4. Concerning parables, which question is contained?
thirty_pointers.answer: If you can't understand the meaning of this parable, how will you understand all the other parables?

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation question. From Mark chapter 4. Quote the 15th verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message, only to have Satan come at once and take it away.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation question. From Mark chapter 4. Quote the 16th verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: The seed on the rocky soil represents those who hear the message and immediately receive it with joy.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” What happens to people who don't have, quote, “deep roots”?
thirty_pointers.answer: But since they don't have deep roots, they don't last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God's word.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, "Parable of the Farmer Scattering Seed.” The closing verse contains which exclamation?
thirty_pointers.answer: And the seed that fell on good soil represents those who hear and accept God's word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Chapter analysis answer. From Mark chapter 4. Verse 21 contains which question and which exclamation?
thirty_pointers.answer: Would anyone light a lamp and then put it under a basket or under a bed? Of course not!

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give a complete answer. From Mark chapter 4. Jesus added what?
thirty_pointers.answer: Then he added, “Pay close attention to what you hear. The closer you listen, the more understanding you will be given— and you will receive even more.”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation completion question. From Mark chapter 4. Finish this verse, quote, “To those who listen…”
thirty_pointers.answer: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence completion question. From Mark chapter 4. Finish in essence this verse, quote, “Night and day...”
thirty_pointers.answer: Night and day, while he's asleep or awake, the seed sprouts and grows, but he does not understand how it happens.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence completion question. Mark chapter 4. Finish in essence this verse, quote, “When Jesus woke...”
thirty_pointers.answer: When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Silence! Be still!” Suddenly the wind stopped, and there was a great calm.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part chapter analysis answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” The demon-possessed man screamed what?
thirty_pointers.answer: Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In the name of God, I beg you, don't torture me!

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation question. From Mark. Quote verse 7 from the 5th chapter.
thirty_pointers.answer: With a shriek, he screamed, “Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In the name of God, I beg you, don't torture me!”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: 2-Part question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” What did Jesus ask the spirit, and what was the spirit's response?
thirty_pointers.answer: Then Jesus demanded, “What is your name?” And he replied, “My name is Legion, because there are many of us inside this man.”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation question. From Mark chapter 5. Quote the 13th verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: So Jesus gave them permission. The evil spirits came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd of about 2,000 pigs plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Scripture text question. Give a complete answer. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man.” How did Jesus respond when the man who had been demon-possessed, quote, “begged to go with him”?
thirty_pointers.answer: But Jesus said, “No, go home to your family, and tell them everything the Lord has done for you and how merciful he has been.”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Give 2 complete answers. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals a Demon- Possessed Man.” According to the closing verse, what did the man do?
thirty_pointers.answer: So the man started off to visit the Ten Towns of that region and began to proclaim the great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed at what he told them.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence completion question. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Finish in essence this verse, quote, “pleading fervently with him...”
thirty_pointers.answer: pleading fervently with him. “My little daughter is dying,” he said. “Please come and lay your hands on her; heal her so she can live.”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Quotation question. From Mark chapter 5. Quote the 29th verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: Immediately the bleeding stopped, and she could feel in her body that she had been healed of her terrible condition.

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence completion question. From Mark chapter 5. Finish in essence this verse, quote, “While he was still...”
thirty_pointers.answer: While he was still speaking to her, messengers arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. They told him, “Your daughter is dead. There's no use troubling the Teacher now.”

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence question. From the section titled, “Jesus Heals in Response to Faith.” Give in essence the verse in which James is named.
thirty_pointers.answer: Then Jesus stopped the crowd and wouldn't let anyone go with him except Peter, James, and John (the brother of James).

thirty_pointers.prompt_and_question: Essence question. From Mark chapter 5. Give in essence the closing verse.
thirty_pointers.answer: Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anyone what had happened, and then he told them to give her something to eat.
